Welcome to MineFighter Competitive Team
Welcome to MineFighter team, The New Competition Team.
This team was formerly named Heroes, But due to misunderstanding users, I have closed the Apps, Renamed to 'MineFighter'.

Join Requirements
Must be fluent at pvp.
You need a discord for chatting with us.
That's all!

How to join our team
This time, You need to follow the format in this threads.

Your Minecraft Username:
Your Discord Username:
(Note: Write your discord username on Avicus)
Reason to Participation:

Fighters are always welcome!

May 5th, 2017 Update: Team Rules Removed.
